page.overview:
Who is Mr. Cunningham?

Mr. Cunningham is a villainous minifigure from the Adventurers theme in 2000. He is included in three different LEGO sets.

Mr. Cunningham wears a dark grey jacket over a grey-and-red striped shirt that exposes his belly button, implying that he is overweight. He wears earth orange pants, with 5955 All Terrain Trapper having a black hip piece and other sets having an earth orange hip. His hat is an earth orange Safari Hat. His face is printed with brown sideburns, eyebrows, a mustache, and stubble.

Mr. Cunningham is a tough henchman working for Sam Sinister and Alexia Sinister in their plot to capture dinosaurs from Dino Island. According to LEGO Mania Magazine, he is a master of disguise and has been known to change his disguises weekly.

In The Championship Challenge, Mr. Cunningham gets into a fight with Dr. Lightning in the stands after Sam Sinister tackles an all-star player. In Double Trouble on Dino Island, Mr. Cunningham flies the Research Glider and informs Sinister about Johnny Thunder and Mike making a crash-landing on Dino Island.
